gizmo.title: Element documentation player
gizmo.description: Animated walkthrough, demo, documentation and schema for a web component, with copy buttons for HTML, import, npm and CDN.

configure.title: Docs data file
configure.description: The generated docs file for the element (name.docs.json).

configure.title: Walkthrough storyboard
configure.description: The motion storyboard that ships with the element (tag.motion.json). Optional.

configure.title: Autoplay walkthrough
configure.description: Start the walkthrough as soon as the player shows. Ignored when the reader prefers reduced motion.

advanced.title: Live demo link
advanced.description: Where the Open demo source button goes. Defaults to the demo folder in the repository.

advanced.title: Documentation link
advanced.description: Where the full documentation button goes, for example the matching Learn HAX page.
